# HitLai

> The AI that runs your business — alongside the people and systems you already have. HitLai (from "HITL AI", human-in-the-loop AI) is AI automation for small and mid-size businesses: AI drafts and does the work, and the owner decides how much of it a person reviews first. Built on AICtrlNet by Bodaty LLC. Ready in minutes; we set it up with you.

## Core pages

- [Features](https://hitlai.net/features/): what HitLai does day-to-day
- [Pricing](https://hitlai.net/pricing/): two plans, expert hours included
- [Industries](https://hitlai.net/industries/): industry-specific AI workflows
- [Autonomy](https://hitlai.net/autonomy/): how the owner sets how much AI runs on its own
- [Trial](https://hitlai.net/trial/): start free
- [Demo](https://hitlai.net/demo/): see it running
- [Free AI-visibility audit](https://hitlai.net/audit/): see how AI search engines describe your business
- [Institute](https://hitlai.net/institute/): hands-on AI workshops for business owners
